notes: Source account: L05 dates the notice at Montpellier on 18 octobre 1983; L08 gives N° 4570. L09–L19 announce a doctor-engineer thesis defense for MOUFADDAL Mohamed under the quoted subject heading ECOLOGIE GENERALE ET APPLIQUEE option ECOLOGIE TERRESTRE, with the title concerning possibilities of extending the Atlas cedar beyond its present range. The notice gives Le 28 octobre 1983 à 14 heures and the Institut de Botanique, names M. GODRON Michel as director, and identifies the laboratory in its own two-line wording. L20–L28 describe the study's historical, climatic and plantation-comparison work; these are statements printed in the notice, not independently verified research results. The source heading is Aanlyse and remains so. L29 gives 5 ans. L30–L34 list the proposed jury exactly as typed. L35–L39 contain the delegated-signatory wording, an unresolved pen signature rendered graphically, and the separate typed A. GENTIL. L40 is a lighter marginal 9. The whole scan and each supplied full-resolution half were viewed once, then all six saved tight crops were inspected. Every ordinary word, name, punctuation mark, underline and numerical item was checked against the image; there is no witness H or C/H difference-row list. The line-ending dendromé- / trique is preserved with its visible hyphen and line break; this is source-layout retention of the same word and is not counted as an independent lexical error. The letterhead's thirteen carets, heading's sixty equals, typed dates/reference/duration, and marginal number are all included. No OCR, external research, second-reading crops, TeX compilation, proof checking or mathematical computation was performed. Blind audit confirms the composite r and a cells without determining the prior glyphs or typing order. The first local uncertainty states and the underline gap beneath n remain. A small gap at the signature stem foot is added to its contour; no alphabetic completion is supplied.
